recommendation: Keep this source fix. It completes the already-applied Jira decision and removes a stale canonical reference to a no-longer-present non-example RiskAssessment method ValueSet.
issue_request: FHIR-55077 was an Applied/Persuasive CDS change request asking that the RiskAssessment method and outcome ValueSets and CodeSystems be marked experimental and have Example added to each id, url, name, and title.
initial_application: Commit e0d4878affc790cbd8b261d31034315a72bbbd89 applied the issue by renaming the RiskAssessment method and outcome ValueSet and CodeSystem source files, updating the StructureDefinition bindings to the new example ValueSet URLs, marking the artifacts experimental, and adding the RiskAssessment ballot-note entry. That application missed one internal CodeSystem.valueSet canonical in the method CodeSystem.
additional_context: RiskAssessment is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/riskassessment terminology files feed the current build. The outcome CodeSystem already points to ValueSet/risk-assessment-outcome-example, the method ValueSet includes the method example CodeSystem, and no non-example method ValueSet source remains. Quoted Zulip and Confluence searches found no community record that changes the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: Updated source/riskassessment/codesystem-risk-assessment-method-example.xml so its CodeSystem.valueSet points to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/risk-assessment-method-example, matching the renamed ValueSet and the rest of the FHIR-55077 application.
